property_summary: After a successful burn by owner, the sum of all indexed balances (balanceOf msg.sender) must still equal totalSupply; the buggy burn omits decreasing totalSupply, so after one burn totalSupply stays larger than the actual sum of balances (since the zero address is excluded, the owner's balance minus the burned amount equals totalSupply only if totalSupply is decreased).
change_summary: Remove the line `totalSupply -= _value;` so burn no longer decreases totalSupply.
